reason_for_revision: v1 showed that an exact profile-TV cap penalizes a bounded fixed-MC reconstruction for sub-percent TV differences. v2 restores the original 2% profile-TV tolerance while retaining exact cell conservation and local bounds.

model.name: TVD-FV plus jump-gated conservative DKAN subcells

benchmark.note: These amplitudes were not evaluated during v1 or sensor development. The target sine family and viscosity 0.001 were absent from pretraining.

primary_metric.definition: fixed-MC normalized L2 divided by gated-DKAN normalized L2
primary_metric.aggregate: geometric mean over all 14 parameter cases per seed, followed by median over five seeds
primary_metric.success: median aggregate gain >= 1.20 and bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound > 1.00

secondary_gates.per_case_no_material_degradation: gated L2 <= 1.05 * fixed-MC L2 for every seed-case pair

claim_boundary: Passing supports the Burgers subcell branch only; Euler and the final ten-seed float64 protocol remain required for the overall 20% claim.

outcome.evidence: At amplitude 0.55 and viscosity 0.001, gated-DKAN L2 was 59.66% worse than fixed MC.
outcome.diagnosis: The fixed reconstruction had 3.91% reference-relative TV excess and 3.33% initial-TV excess. The 2% cap projected the fallback profile and dominated its already small error.
